study: Single-cell multi-omic landscape reveals anatomical-specific immune features in adult and pediatric sepsis (Nat Immunol 2025)

material: whole blood, total leukocytes (not PBMC — neutrophils retained)

verdict: cohort contains ~3 fatal single-cell donors but they cannot be selected: no per-patient death label anywhere; also whole blood, not PBMC
